causes.label: Dryer is unplugged
remedies: Make sure the dryer plug is pushed completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Dryer is unplugged"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped
remedies: Check the household Distribution Panel fuse/circuit breaker box in your home, and replace fuse or reset breaker.
NOTE: Electric dryers use two fuses or breakers.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped"

causes.label: Thermal limiter tripped
remedies: Check the vent for any obstructions.
Call authorized service person for replacement if necessary.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Thermal limiter tripped"

causes.label: Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat
remedies: Check the fuse/circuit breaker box in your home, and replace both fuses or reset both breakers.
Your dryer may tumble if only one fuse is blown or one breaker tripped.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped; the dryer may tumble but not heat"

causes.label: Gas service is off
remedies: Make sure gas shutoff at dryer and main shutoff are fully open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Gas service is off"

causes.label: LP gas supply tank is empty or there has been a utility interruption of natural gas (gas models)
remedies: Refill or replace tank.
Dryer should heat when utility service is restored.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "LP gas supply tank is empty or there has been a utility interruption of natural gas (gas models)"

causes.label: Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly
remedies: Move dryer to an even floor space, or adjust leveling legs as necessary until even.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Some shaking/noise is normal. Dryer may be sitting unevenly"

causes.label: Improper use of fabric softener
remedies: Follow directions on fabric softener package.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Improper use of fabric softener"

causes.label: Drying dirty items with clean ones
remedies: Use your dryer to dry only clean items.
Dirty items can stain clean items and the dryer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Drying dirty items with clean ones"

causes.label: Clothes were not completely clean
remedies: Sometimes stains which cannot be seen when the clothes are wet appear after drying.
Use proper washing procedures before drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Clothes were not completely clean"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint screen before each load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Sort lint producers (like chenille) from lint collectors (like corduroy).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Static electricity can attract lint
remedies: See suggestions in this section under STATIC.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Static electricity can attract lint"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Overloading"

causes.label: Paper, tissue, etc. left in pockets
remedies: Empty all pockets before laundering clothes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Paper, tissue, etc. left in pockets"

causes.label: No fabric softener was used
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Bounce® Fabric Conditioner Dryer Sheets have been approved for use in all GE Dryers when used in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "No fabric softener was used"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
Adjust controls to LESS DRY.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static
remedies: Try a fabric softener.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 20: "Synthetics, permanent press and blends can cause static"

causes.label: Type of heat
remedies: Automatic drying times will vary according to the type of heat used (electric, natural or LP gas), size of load, types of fabrics, wetness of clothes and condition of exhaust ducts.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Type of heat"

symptoms.symptom: Clothes take too long to dry

causes.label: Improper sorting
remedies: Separate heavy items from lightweight items (generally, a well-sorted washer load is a well-sorted dryer load).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Improper sorting"

causes.label: Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)
remedies: Large, heavy fabrics contain more moisture and take longer to dry.
Separate large, heavy fabrics into smaller loads to speed drying time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Large loads of heavy fabrics (like beach towels)"

causes.label: Controls improperly set
remedies: Match control settings to the load you are drying.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Controls improperly set"

causes.label: Lint filter is full
remedies: Clean lint filter before every load.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Lint filter is full"

causes.label: Improper or obstructed ducting
remedies: Check installation instructions for proper ducting/venting.
Make sure ducting is clean, free of kinks and unobstructed.
Check to see if outside wall damper operates easily.
Check the Installation Instructions to make sure the dryer venting is correct.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Improper or obstructed ducting"

causes.label: Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker
remedies: Replace fuses or reset circuit breakers.
Since most dryers use two fuses or breakers, make sure both are operating.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Blown fuses or tripped circuit breaker"

causes.label: Overloading/combining loads
remedies: Do not put more than one washer load in the dryer at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Overloading/combining loads"

causes.label: Underloading
remedies: If you are drying only one or two items, add a few items to ensure proper tumbling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Underloading"

causes.label: Overdrying
remedies: Select a shorter drying time.
Remove items while they still hold a slight amount of moisture.
Select a LESS DRY setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Overdrying"

causes.label: Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends
remedies: Remove items when cycle ends and fold or hang immediately.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Letting items sit in dryer after cycle ends"

causes.label: Overloading
remedies: Separate large loads into smaller ones.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 21: "Overloading"
